report.answer: During registration, node.insertChild (tree.go:288) splits a path at each ':name' wildcard via findWildcard, creating a dedicated child node of nType=param whose path field stores the wildcard string (e.g. ":name") and sets the parent's wildChild=true. During matching, node.getValue (tree.go:418, param case ~line 484) locates that wildChild as the last entry in n.children, scans the remaining request path up to the next '/' (or end of string) to find the segment end, and stores a Param{Key: n.path[1:], Value: path[:end]} (stripping the leading ':') into the Params slice — optionally URL-unescaping the value — before continuing the walk into any deeper children or returning the matched handlers.

verified.summary: insertChild creates a child node{nType: param, path: wildcard} (wildcard includes leading ':') when it encounters ':name' in the route path, and sets n.wildChild = true on the parent
verified.evidence: ghx read gin-gonic/gin tree.go --lines 253-400 (insertChild, param branch)

verified.summary: getValue's param case scans path until '/' or end (variable `end`), then writes Param{Key: n.path[1:], Value: val} into *value.params, applying url.QueryUnescape when unescape=true
verified.evidence: ghx read gin-gonic/gin tree.go --lines 460-671 (case param block)

verified.summary: Wildcard child is always stored as n.children[len(n.children)-1] and is selected when no static index byte matches; globalParamsCount is incremented to track capacity for the Params slice
Catch-all (*name) params are captured similarly but store the remaining full path as Value and strip 2 leading chars (n.path[2:]) for the key
